question: Should maintainers keep waiting for contributor proof/rebase on this uneditable conflicting PR, or replace it with a maintainer-owned current-main fix for the still-open hook accountId bug?
rationale: The patch direction is useful, but the branch cannot be repaired in place by maintainers and the missing live delivery proof cannot be supplied by automation for the contributor's setup.

options.title: Replace on current main
options.body: Open or sponsor a narrow credited replacement PR that ports the fix to current SourceDeliveryPlan and supplies maintainer-owned proof.

options.title: Wait for contributor refresh
options.body: Leave this PR open for the author to rebase, enable maintainer edits or push an update, and add redacted real behavior proof.

options.title: Close after cleanup window
options.body: If maintainers decide not to wait, close this PR while keeping the canonical issue open for a fresh fix.

recommendation.title: Replace on current main
recommendation.body: Open or sponsor a narrow credited replacement PR that ports the fix to current SourceDeliveryPlan and supplies maintainer-owned proof.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is the strongest current-main routing candidate from recent gateway/source-delivery history and was explicitly requested for review in the PR discussion.
